headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Consolidated quarterly revenue from commercial autonomous hauling contracts and pilot customer freight programs.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Commercial Freight & Pilot Revenue ($M): Early-stage commercialization revenue generated by Aurora Driver hauling loads for FedEx, Schneider, Werner, and Uber Freight between Dallas and Houston. Consensus models $2.2M in Q3 2026E vs $2.0M reported in Q2 2026.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Wall Street consensus Diluted EPS for Q3 2026E (-$0.13) vs Buy-Side Whisper (-$0.11).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Diluted EPS ($): Sell-side consensus expects -$0.13 per share in Q3 2026E as R&D investment remains intensive ahead of driver-out deployment; whisper looks for -$0.11 on tight SG&A cost containment.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Autonomy Readiness Safety Case Closure Rate (%)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Percentage of safety claims validated and closed for driverless commercial operations on launch lanes.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Autonomy Readiness Safety Case: Cumulative validation metric tracking completion of evidence showing Aurora Driver is acceptably safe to operate without a safety driver on public highways. Closed at 95% in Q2 2026; Street targets 98%+ in Q3 2026E.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Commercial Autonomous Miles Driven Cumulative (M Miles)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total cumulative autonomous commercial miles driven under dispatch for commercial freight customers.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Commercial Autonomous Miles: Cumulative on-highway miles hauled autonomously with commercial freight on the Dallas-Houston lane. Exceeded 2.5M miles in Q2 2026; Street expects >3.2M miles in Q3 2026E.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Quarterly Cash Burn / Net Operating Cash Outflow ($M)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Net operating cash burn per quarter reflecting engineering, testing, and fleet operations expense.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Quarterly Operating Cash Burn ($M): Operating cash outflow was -$225M in Q2 2026; Street models -$215M to -$225M in Q3 2026E with cash runway extending past year-end 2026.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Driverless Trucking Commercial Launch Timeline Confirmation
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Management affirmation of scheduled removal of vehicle operators on the Dallas-to-Houston corridor.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Commercial Launch Schedule: Confirmation of the milestone removal of human in-cab safety operators ('Driver-Out') in commercial freight operations, expected to commence by late 2026 / early 2027.
